one_provenance.kind: per-model island memetic search, IDENTICAL budget across models and seeds
one_provenance.statistic: the SLOWER of two independent seeds (conservative: cannot flatter a model whose search converged better)
one_provenance.is_a_lower_bound_not_the_optimum: an optimizer output bounds the true optimum from one side only; every normalized score is therefore an upper bound on the true normalized score
